blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The defense lawyers of former President Rodrigo Duterte are asking a trial chamber of the International Criminal Court (ICC) for another round of medical examinations that would allow a neurologist and other medical experts to formally assess the detained ex-leader ahead of his trial.
